items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Wilbur Tillman; the interviewer states 'I knew Dude, man. He used to play with Joe Avery and Wilbur Tillman.'

ctx.x: And I used to play in the show. I used to play in church. I used to play in concerts, you know? Mm-hmm. Sing, dance, bunk dance. There's a great bunk dance. I used to be a great bunk dancer. Sing. And there's Lincoln Show and I used to be back on Lutheran Island and Howard. Mm-hmm. I used to play there every Friday night with the seven piece orchestra. That's when they had the Charleston out. That's a father named Foster Lewis and Dude Lewis.
I knew Dude, man. He used to play with Joe Avery and Wilbur Tillman. That's a guy I knew, Dude. Yeah, he's dead. I have a record in my collection of him.
Yeah, and his brother called him Foster Stan. He's dead too. The tribal place. They both buried.
